name: SWEEP-S5v1 Rich and poor
_design: Inequality: 8 identical agents alternate around a ring in a 13x13 world; four start with 400 compute, four with 40. A tree on every start point plus 2 more. Question: do the poor ask, do the rich give (transfer), or does someone take?
